capabilities: Show a dictionary popup with readings and meanings when a word is selected
Look up words bidirectionally (Japanese-English and English-Japanese)
Deinflect conjugated Japanese verb and adjective forms before lookup
Trigger lookups on selections inside PDFs, with text normalization
Switch between full and lite dictionary data files and tune popup settings
extras: Dictionary data (~30 MB full, ~4 MB lite) is downloaded from the repository's GitHub releases on first load; this is the plugin's only network access. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dictionary lookup, and Japanese learners need offline, bidirectional lookups with verb deinflection that also work in PDFs.

relations.evidence: An offline Japanese-English / English-Japanese popup dictionary for Obsidian, powered by JMdict.
build_dict.py generates the compact dictionary files from a jmdict-simplified JSON release.

summary: Offline Japanese-English popup dictionary powered by JMdict that shows readings and meanings for a selected word, including inside PDFs.
